presentation.summary: Control jam-clearing work when guarding and hazardous-energy conditions are uncertain.
presentation.situation: A packaging machine is repeatedly jamming. Production pressure is increasing and a guard interlock has become unreliable.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A packaging machine is repeatedly jamming. Production pressure is increasing and a guard interlock has become unreliable.

work_authorization_record.title: Jam-Clearance Energy Review
work_authorization_record.summary: The machine is stopped locally, but an opened guard exposes the operator to the hazard zone.
details: Pressing the local stop does not by itself establish an isolated or zero-energy condition.
The jam is reachable through an opened guard, placing the task inside the machine's danger area.
Electrical, pneumatic and stored mechanical energy must be considered before hands or tools enter the hazard zone.

control_verification_record.title: Stored-Energy Verification
control_verification_record.summary: The electrical disconnect is locked, but pneumatic energy remains available to an actuator.
details: Electrical isolation alone does not control the remaining pneumatic source.
Residual pressure can still create hazardous movement even with the main electrical disconnect locked.
The energy-control record is incomplete until stored energy is relieved or restrained and a zero-energy condition is verified.

condition_change_record.title: Guard Interlock Defect Record
condition_change_record.summary: The guard interlock behaves intermittently during post-clearance testing.
details: The safeguarding system cannot be relied on to stop or prevent hazardous motion consistently.
The defect changes the machine condition from a cleared jam to an unresolved safeguarding failure.
A successful test cycle does not cancel the significance of an intermittent interlock fault.

response_record.title: Unexpected Movement Event Record
response_record.summary: Residual energy caused unexpected mechanism movement during controlled troubleshooting.
details: Unexpected movement demonstrates that the hazardous-energy assessment was not complete.
The newly identified energy source must be incorporated into the isolation and verification process.
The event is a control failure that requires the hazard zone to remain secured until energy control is re-established.

closeout_record.title: Machine Return-to-Service Check
closeout_record.summary: Repairs are complete and the machine is approaching the point where energy-control devices may be removed.
details: Guards, interlocks and other protective devices need to be restored and verified before normal operation.
The work area should be checked for personnel, tools and temporary restraints before re-energization.
Removal of energy-control devices and restart should follow the authorized return-to-service sequence.

prejob_decision_defensible.observable: The situation is partly controlled, but a remaining gap requires recovery.
prejob_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: A partial control is not equivalent to completing every prerequisite.

prejob_decision_best.observable: The work remains controlled and the next stage is approached with the required safeguards verified.
prejob_decision_best.guidedInsight: Verify the complete control sequence before work continues.

prejob_decision_weak.observable: The control gap increases exposure and weakens the work position.
prejob_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Schedule pressure should not replace verification.

prejob_decision_critical.observable: The decision creates a serious loss of control.
prejob_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Do not substitute assumptions for verified control.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
